title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're working with a well-established UK training / development business to hire a Senior Marketing Manager to own the growth plan, lead targets, and go hands-on across the key demand channels.

This is a true "lead it, and do it" role: you'll set the marketing direction across multiple product lines, while personally driving performance across search, website conversion, and database/lifecycle marketing. You'll also lead and develop a Marketing & Growth Manager (who oversees day-to-day activity with solid foundations already in place).

Role: Senior Marketing Manager
Location: Liverpool Centre (Hybrid)
Type: Permanent
Salary: DOA

Key responsibilities include:
- Own the marketing strategy and annual plan (agreed with directors) across multiple business lines
- Take full ownership of the lead target and where budget/effort should be allocated to hit it
- Drive demand generation hands-on: SEO/AEO, website optimisation and conversion rate improvement
- Maximise value from an existing CRM/database: segmentation, comms, nurture journeys, cross-sell/upsell lead generation
- Develop positioning and messaging that resonates with senior decision-makers
- Produce monthly performance reporting (HubSpot) demonstrating marketing impact on pipeline
- Lead through others: manage and develop a Marketing & Growth Manager

Key skills and experience:
- Senior B2 B marketing experience with a track record of generating qualified leads for "considered purchase" services
- Strong, hands-on capability in search (SEO/AEO) and website conversion
- Lifecycle / CRM / database marketing experience (nurture, segmentation, repeat/cross-sell)
- Confidence using HubSpot and turning data into clear commercial decisions
- "AI-first" mindset and curiosity-able to adapt as search shifts towards AI-led answers
- Strong commercial judgement and ability to write credible, compelling copy for senior audiences
- Proven people leadership (developing a manager)

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Join the Party - We're Looking for a Paid Media Specialist!

Location: Liverpool City Centre (Hybrid)
Salary: 32,000 - 40,000, dependent on experience + bonus opportunities

Zachary Daniels Recruitment is delighted to be partnering with a leading entertainment and hospitality group that has taken the UK and international event scene by storm.

We're looking for an experienced Paid Media Specialist to take ownership of paid media activity across a fast-moving, high-energy brand.

With an always-on calendar spanning 40+ venues, seasonal campaigns, new launches and brand collaborations, this is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being hands-on and seeing the direct impact of their work.

You'll own paid media end-to-end - from strategy and budget allocation through to campaign execution, optimisation and reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own paid media strategy across 40+ venues, seasonal campaigns and key launches.
- Build, launch and optimise campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Google Ads and Performance Max.
- Manage budgets across venues and campaigns to maximise performance.
- React quickly to sold-out events, new on-sales and schedule or venue changes.
- Run structured test-and-learn programmes across creative, audiences and bidding.
- Optimise campaigns against agreed KPIs including CPA and ROAS.
- Deliver weekly and monthly reporting using GA4 and attribution data.
- Work closely with Design, Video, Organic Social and CRM teams on campaign delivery.
- Support the expansion into YouTube and explore emerging channels and formats.
- Manage relationships with key platform partners including Meta, TikTok and Google.

What We're Looking For:
- 4+ years' paid media experience, agencyside or in-house.
- Strong hands-on experience across Meta and TikTok, with Snapchat, Pinterest and/or Google experience desirable.
- Confidence owning paid media from strategy through to execution and reporting.
- Strong working knowledge of Ads Manager platforms.
- A data-led mindset with experience using GA4 and reporting tools such as Looker Studio.
- Experience in a fast-paced, high-volume campaign environment.
- Strong understanding of ROAS, CPA, LTV and Share of Voice.
- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Codex or Claude to improve productivity and campaign performance.

Nice to Have:
- Google Ads / Performance Max experience.
- Experience in events, hospitality, entertainment or nightlife.
- Experience managing monthly paid media budgets of 30,000+.

What's in it for You?
- A four-day work week.
- Hybrid working from Liverpool city centre.
- 32,000 - 40,000 salary, dependent on experience.
- Bonus opportunities.
- Complimentary event tickets.
- A fast-paced, creative environment with real ownership and impact.
- Regular team socials and a fun, innovative culture.

If you're an experienced Paid Media Specialist who loves being hands-on, thrives in a fast-moving environment and wants to take real ownership of paid media, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's talk!

description:
International eCommerce & Marketplace Executive
- Location: Liverpool (Office Based)
- Languages: Fluent English plus ANY 2nd language, ideally German, French, Dutch, Arabic, Spanish but all languages considered
- Salary: Up to £35,000 + Excellent Benefits

We are recruiting on behalf of a successful and rapidly growing international consumer products business for an International eCommerce & Marketplace Executive to support expansion across key European markets including Germany, France, Spain and the Benelux region. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded marketing professional with language skills and experience in eCommerce, digital marketing or international market development to join a recognised global brand with a strong international presence across Europe and global markets.

The Role

As the International eCommerce & Marketplace Executive, you will work closely with marketing, eCommerce, sales and international partners to drive brand awareness, customer engagement and online sales growth across multiple European territories, including Germany, France, Spain and the Benelux region.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating localised marketing campaigns and product launches across European markets
- Building and managing influencer and creator partnerships within target territories
- Supporting the localisation of social media content and digital marketing activity
- Working with distributors and retail partners to deliver effective brand activations and promotional campaigns
- Coordinating translations and market-specific content requirements
- Supporting e-commerce operations through optimised product listings, merchandising and promotional activity
- Monitoring marketplace performance, identifying sales opportunities and resolving listing or content issues
- Producing regular reports on campaign performance, website traffic, conversion rates and market trends
- Conducting competitor and market analysis to identify growth opportunities

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Fluent English plus ANY 2nd language, ideally German, French, Dutch, Arabic, Spanish but all languages considered
- Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, international marketing or marketplace operations
- Strong project coordination and organisational skills
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
- Strong analytical skills with experience using Excel or Google Sheets
- High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Experience of Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central or European online marketplaces would be beneficial
- Previous experience within FMCG, sports nutrition, consumer goods, health, wellness, nutrition or sports-related sectors would be advantageous

Salary & Benefits
- Competitive salary up to £35,000
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Employee Assistance Programme
- 50% staff discount on products
- Complimentary products in the office
- Free on-site parking
- Opportunity to join a rapidly growing international business and play a key role in its European expansion

Apply Now

If you have experience in eCommerce, digital marketing or marketplace operations and are looking to join a fast-growing international business, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today by sending your CV to Jonathan Grimes

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)

- Branding and Positioning

- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements

- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
